display_name: SEO Rules & Search Intent Vault (Semrush / Ahrefs / Google Search Central)

entries.title: Search Intent & Primary Keyword Alignment
entries.summary: Align H1, page title (30 to 60 characters), slug, and opening 100 words to a single primary search intent without keyword stuffing.
rules: Place the primary keyword naturally in the H1, page title (30 to 60 chars), and clean lowercase hyphenated slug.
Keep meta descriptions compelling between 120 and 160 characters with a concrete value proposition.
Avoid duplicate titles across published pages and eliminate thin pages under 300 words on editorial hubs.
citations: Google Search Central SEO Starter Guide

entries.title: AnswerThePublic Question Clusters & Featured Snippet Structure
entries.summary: Capture long-tail discovery traffic by pairing question-based H2 subheadings with concise 40-to-60-word direct answers and FAQPage JSON-LD.
rules: Group reader questions by intent modifier (how, why, best, cost, delivery, reading order).
Answer each question cleanly in the first two sentences immediately following the H2 or Accordion summary.
Pair visible semantic Accordion FAQs with XSS-escaped FAQPage JSON-LD without hiding text off-screen.
citations: Google Search Central Structured Data Policies

entries.title: Internal Linking Graph, 301 Redirect Hygiene & Orphan Rescue
entries.summary: Maintain zero orphan pages, descriptive anchor text, at most 1 redirect hop, and zero 301 redirect loops across SITE-CONTEXT.md.
rules: Every published book, series, or article must receive at least 1 contextual internal link from a hub or sibling entry.
Replace generic anchor text ('click here', 'read more') with descriptive topic-specific phrases.
Resolve 301 redirect chains to direct canonical destinations and exclude loop targets before emitting link suggestions.

entries.title: ADR-025c Merchant & Book Offer Numeric Exactness
entries.summary: Preserve exact base-10 GrabDecimal wire strings for all storefront prices, discounts, shipping costs, and SKU counts so Google Merchant and checkout stay identical.
rules: Always transmit monetary prices and inventory counts as exact base-10 wire strings ('2.99', '4.99', '12.99', '14.99', '16.99').
Reject IEEE-754 floating-point numbers and scientific notation with HTTP 422 before staging or publishing.
Ensure visible storefront price text matches schema.org Offer.price character-for-character.
